contract_name: Enterprise Cloud Services and Support Agreement
termination_rights: usage-based services may be reduced, but committed-use shortfall applies through term
contract_english_overview: Enterprise AWS cloud consumption agreement covering committed-use economics, support, EC2, RDS, data-transfer usage, resource inventory, tag quality, and AP reconciliation for named healthcare workloads. Source treats this as coverage, rightsizing, and governance discipline rather than commitment reduction.
scope_english_summary: Loaded scope covers the EHR interface platform, patient digital front door, and integration services hub with explicit contract-and-tag mappings. It does not prove every AWS-hosted enterprise system is covered by this contract package.
commercial_thesis: The governed financial fields show actual annual spend above the committed run rate. The commercial posture is to move durable usage into commitment coverage, rightsize low-utilization resources, reduce avoidable egress, and review support economics before the next EDP cycle.
relationship_summary: The governed relationship is AWS vendor to contract MER-CLOUD-AWS-001, named application scopes, monthly billing/AP rows, usage, resource, tag-quality evidence, and AWS-linked opportunity/control rows.
evidence_boundary_summary: Structured rows are loaded for spend, commitments, coverage, resources, tag quality, AP reconciliation, clauses, and opportunities. Values are synthetic demo evidence and candidate actions remain not finance-confirmed.

contract_name: Azure Enterprise Agreement for Data and Analytics
termination_rights: enterprise agreement reduction rights limited by minimum annual monetary commitment
contract_english_overview: Azure Enterprise Agreement for data and analytics workloads covering EA commitment economics, reservations, Synapse and SQL usage, resource inventory, tag quality, and AP reconciliation. Source treats this as reservation coverage, scheduling, and tag-governance execution.
scope_english_summary: Loaded scope covers claims analytics lake, security event lake, enterprise data platform, and integration services hub through explicit contract-and-tag mappings. It does not prove all Microsoft estate consumption or collaboration tools are in scope.
commercial_thesis: The governed financial fields show actual annual spend above the committed run rate. The commercial posture is to increase reservation coverage, schedule idle analytics pools, and close owner/application tag gaps before any business-unit savings attribution.
relationship_summary: The governed relationship is Microsoft vendor to contract MER-CLOUD-AZURE-001, named application scopes, monthly cost-management/AP rows, reservation coverage evidence, and Azure-linked opportunity/control rows.
evidence_boundary_summary: Structured rows are loaded for spend, commitments, coverage, resources, tag quality, AP reconciliation, clauses, and opportunities. Values are synthetic demo evidence and candidate actions remain not finance-confirmed.
